statement: n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → Hmeasure s E = 0
proof:
intro hn
subst n
have hsub : (Set.univ : Set (V 0)).Subsingleton := Set.subsingleton_univ
have hE : E = Set.univ := by
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h_H001
  simpa only [hsub (Set.mem_univ x) (Set.mem_univ y)] using hy
refine ⟨hE, ?_⟩
intro s hs
have hd : Metric.ediam E = 0 := Metric.ediam_subsingleton (hsub.mono (Set.subset_univ E))
have hc : coverCost s (fun _ : ℕ => E) = 0 := by
  simp [coverCost, hd, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hs]
apply le_antisymm _ (zero_le _)
apply iSup_le
intro δ
apply iSup_le
intro hδ
have hcov : IsCover δ E (fun _ : ℕ => E) := by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [hd] using (zero_le (ENNReal.ofReal δ))
calc
  Hscale s δ E ≤ coverCost s (fun _ : ℕ => E) := iInf_le_of_le (fun _ : ℕ => E) (iInf_le_of_le hcov le_rfl)
  _ = 0 := hc
